# RunCat365 reference

ANON OS includes an original **ANON Performance Pet** component inspired by the interaction concept of a small animated taskbar/system-tray performance indicator.

The upstream project referenced during design is **RunCat365** by runcat-dev:

- Repository: https://github.com/runcat-dev/RunCat365
- License: Apache License 2.0

ANON OS does **not** bundle the RunCat365 source code or binaries. The ANON Performance Pet is independently implemented for ANON OS, targets the same Windows-native environment, uses the existing ANON runtime telemetry model, and is published as a self-contained .NET 8 component.

This notice is retained to document the design reference and is not an assertion of affiliation with runcat-dev.
